meta_desc: Budget, spending and schedule for all your sites in one place, with an agent that reads the receipts, checks everything overnight and waits for your OK. Join the waitlist.
og_desc: While the site sleeps, Plumo checks. Join the waitlist.
hero_lead: Budget, spending and schedule for all your sites in one place, with an advisor that lets nothing slip. It reads every receipt, tells you how much each phase has spent and how much is left, flags what went over budget and waits for your OK in the morning.
nota_pe: Free to join. We'll email you when a spot opens.

mad_lead: Today the job lives scattered across spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups and somebody's head, and money slips through the cracks in between. Plumo pulls it together and checks it every night, showing where each number came from.
e1_p: Takes the receipt that came in today (transfer, invoice, paid bill, handwritten receipt), reads amount, date and payee, and suggests the phase.
e2_h: Puts it in the right phase
e2_p: Adds each expense to the phase of your budget, the way your spreadsheet already splits the job.
e3_p: Checks spending against budget and progress: the phase that went over budget or fell behind schedule shows up first.
e4_p: Nothing is logged, approved or rescheduled without a person's OK. And everything approved can be undone.
tras_h2: Behind the scenes, the agent pulls together everything the job already has.
tras_lead: Budget, receipts, progress measurements, schedule, taxes: what lives in five places today becomes one. The agent cross-checks it all, asks the rules for the math and hands back a ready proposal. Every thread is a real lookup.

cant_lead2: Nobody fills in forms with mortar on their hands, and the expense goes in the same day, not at month end.

manha_lead: You open Plumo in the car or at the office and see only what needs you, in deadline order. Decide with one tap and see right away what you kept from slipping. Everything is logged with who, when and why.

ciclo_h2: From budget to the last payment, without letting go halfway.
ciclo_lead: Money slips away between the budget and the last payment: an expense logged twice, a phase going over budget unnoticed, an invoice missing the site ID, paying ahead of the work done. Plumo follows every dollar from the budget to closeout, and doesn't let go halfway.

pr1: Budget, spending, schedule and taxes for every site, with an advisor that looks at everything every night.
pr2: Logging, approving and rescheduling need the OK of someone on your team.
pr3: Every approval is logged with who, when and the math that justified it.
pr4_b: The system does the math, not the AI.
pr4: Spending, balance and delay are calculated by rules; the agent only quotes the result.
lista_lead: How much has each phase of your job spent, right now? And how much is left? We're opening gradually, for small and mid-size builders and for owners running their own build. Tell us a bit about you and we'll let you know when it's your turn.
f1_a: We haven't set pricing yet. People on the list hear first and get founder terms.
f2_q: Do I have to replace my spreadsheet or ERP?
f2_a: No. The idea is to start alongside what you already use and bring the data over gradually.
f3_q: Does the agent log or pay on its own?
f3_a: Never. It reads the receipt, proposes the phase or the schedule and waits for someone on your team to approve. Plumo doesn't buy or pay anything.
f4_q: Do I pay for the AI separately?
f4_a: Your choice: use your own Anthropic key or platform credits, with usage shown per site.
f5_q: What do you do with my email?
f5_a: We only use it to tell you about Plumo. We don't share it, and you can leave the list anytime.
rodape: Keep every site plumb. Made in Brazil.
